claim_scope: transparent_method-development correction; not a prospectively blind benchmark claim

causal_reason.benchmark_contract: The frozen evaluator consumes masks in the registered benchmark image domain, so a query posterior should be rasterized in that same domain rather than the raw LLFF camera-file domain.
causal_reason.camera_contract: The renderer analytically rescales the frozen camera intrinsics to the permitted reference-mask height and width; no target-mask property enters camera calibration.
causal_reason.representation_contract: The scalar query posterior remains independent of the canonical RADIO descriptor patch lattice.
causal_reason.systems_observation: Raw 3024x4032 float32 score arrays caused multi-minute folio_wait_bit_common stalls while writing to the remote mechanical storage, with both GPUs idle.
causal_reason.metric_independence: The resolution is determined solely by the frozen reference-mask shape shared by registered benchmark views, not selected from target metrics. All target metrics were already available during project development, so the experiment remains explicitly non-blind.

remaining_primary_execution.reference_selector: maximum permitted-reference IoU, canonical on exact tie

storage_policy.local_contents: regenerable SAM fields, rendered query scores, receipts, evaluations, and logs
storage_policy.remote_storage: reuse immutable datasets and existing carrier assets in place; do not duplicate them
